name: Attack on Camp Narache
summary: At Camp Narache, you carry a warning that could give the tauren time to call for aid. The Bristleback quilboar are planning a siege, and Chief Hawkwind needs to know.

sections.title: A Plot in the Brambles
sections.body: In Brambleblade Ravine, you find a crude map on the cavern floor. Its dirt-stained markings reveal the Bristleback quilboar plan a long siege against Camp Narache. This is more than a string of scattered attacks.

sections.title: Warning the Chieftain
sections.body: You bring the attack plans to Chief Hawkwind at Camp Narache. Few defenders guard the camp, which shelters young initiates, so Hawkwind prepares to send word to Bloodhoof Village for reinforcements. Your warning gives the camp time to prepare for the siege.

faq.q: Where are the Bristleback attack plans found?
faq.answer: The Bristleback plans are marked on a dirt-stained map inside a cave in Brambleblade Ravine, just up a path to the right of Chief Sharptusk's hut.

faq.q: Who receives the Bristleback attack plans?
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind receives the Bristleback attack plans at the center of Camp Narache.

faq.q: Why are the Bristleback quilboar targeting Camp Narache?
faq.answer: The Bristleback tribe seeks to drive the tauren from Red Cloud Mesa and reclaim Mulgore's hunting grounds and sacred plains for their own kind.

faq.q: How does Chief Hawkwind plan to counter the siege?
faq.answer: Warned by the map, Chief Hawkwind intends to call on their brethren in Bloodhoof Village to reinforce the mesa and repel the assault.

faq.q: Does this quest require speaking to anyone before picking up the map?
aliases: how to start attack on camp narache
faq.answer: No. You find the Dirt-stained Map on the floor of a cave in Brambleblade Ravine. Once retrieved, it becomes the battle plans.

faq.q: What happens if Camp Narache falls?
faq.answer: Camp Narache is the main haven for young tauren braves and their rites of passage. Its loss would threaten Red Cloud Mesa's security and sever Mulgore's spiritual training grounds.

angles.text: As a young tauren brave beginning your earliest rites on the mesa, you prove your loyalty by intercepting the map and protecting your kin from a sudden massacre.
By preserving the tauren's foothold in Mulgore, you help the Horde keep its vital southern anchor in central Kalimdor.
